**sdd/issue-244-a4/design**

## Design — GitLab Substrate Ladder Awareness (slice A4)

File: openspec/changes/issue-244-a4/design.md. Honors owner ruling #565 (3 distinct GitLab rung-1 sub-gates, pipelineMustSucceed load-bearing).

**Decision 1 — rung-1 = 3 parallel sub-gates, provider-aware, OR-composed in evalRung1.** `rungs[1].gates.{pipelineMustSucceed, protectedBranches, preReceive}` each `{available, active, verifiable, mechanism, reason, remedy}`, alongside untouched `brainWritesReviewed`. `verifiable:true` for pipelineMustSucceed/protectedBranches (API-read); `preReceive` = `verifiable:false, mechanism:'config-declared; verify via install runbook'`. Three tiny pure evaluators mirror evalBrainWritesReviewedGate EXACTLY (provider-branch inside). CRITICAL behavior-preservation: existing rung-1 tests pass NO provider, so the else/unset branch of evalPipelineMustSucceedGate reproduces today's contexts logic (status===200 && hasOurContexts) verbatim; protectedBranches else-branch active=false (GitHub arming is contexts-keyed, bare protection does NOT arm). GitLab: pipelineMustSucceed.active = only_allow_merge_if_pipeline_succeeds===true; protectedBranches.active = status===200 (per-branch). evalPreReceiveGate REPLACES the :98-100 short-circuit — same arming (selfHostedPreReceive===true) now carrying verifiable:false. `active = OR(three)`. selectRung UNTOUCHED. detectSubstrate mutate-adds brainWritesReviewed into gates (was overwrite). top-level available = active || pipelineMustSucceed.available (preserves 403 available:false test).

**Decision 2 — new gitlab.mjs read.** `projectMergeSettings({project}) -> {onlyAllowMergeIfPipelineSucceeds: boolean|null}` via `glab api projects/:id` (setting is on PROJECT object, not protected_branches). Uses glab session like capabilities()/branchProtect() — no pipeline-env read (GATE_FILE). null=uncomputable, never fabricated false. Surfaces ONLY the one field; push-gate comes from per-branch read.

**Decision 3 — probe wiring + honesty contract.** realBranchProtectionProbe provider-branches (mirrors realBrainWritesReviewedProbe). GitLab: inline per-branch `glab api protected_branches/:name` (200/404/403 parity with gh probe — NOT capabilities() which false-positives on empty collection, contradicting CP-A2b mirror evidence) + projectMergeSettings, normalized to {status, contexts:[], pipelineMustSucceed}. CONTRACT: substrate.mjs owns verifiable/mechanism SIGNAL (data); brain-governance-status printSubstrateReport owns CAVEAT TEXT driven SOLELY by verifiable===false. Static line 191 (unconditional 'pre-receive available') REMOVED — pre-receive rendered per-gate, caveat 'armed (config-declared) — not remotely detectable; verify via install runbook' only when active+verifiable:false, never 'verified'.

**Decision 4 — diff-size EXCLUDED from pre-receive.** MR-level delta-vs-base + ignoreList globs ≠ per-push-batch (rev-list oldrev..newrev, no MR base); per-push budget would false-reject and diverge from CI diff-size REQUIRED_JOBS (governance-checks.mjs:24). Hook stays commit-format+ticket-ref, already self-contained sh+git+grep. No new hook binary, no new evaluator.

**Decision 5 — CP-A4a.** Reuse setupFixture/commitAndPush; add APPEND-rejection case (+appendAndPush helper) — push compliant commit creating a file, then append with non-compliant msg → rejected. 4 offline governance-status GitLab fixtures (pipelineMustSucceed-armed / protectedBranches-armed / preReceive-declared-only / none) via injected normalized probe returns. One committed fixtures/gitlab-project.json = derived + _provenance (NEVER recorded), pins GET /projects/:id field shape, curl-verifiable.

**Decision 6 — docs EXTEND self-hosted-pre-receive.md** (GitLab custom_hooks/ already there), no duplication.

**Budget:** ~145 counted lines (substrate ~55, gitlab ~25, governance-status ~40, fixture ~10, docs ~15). Test files + design.md UNCOUNTED (ignoreList **/*.test.mjs, openspec/changes/**). Under 400, no size:exception, no split.

**Open questions for tasks.md:** (1) per-branch read vs capabilities() reuse — chose per-branch for honesty, confirm at review; (2) exact rendered strings; (3) mechanism string values (preReceive verbatim ruling-mandated).
